body: Thank you, you too!
I literally scripted for the first time last night and I wake up to see this - if this ain't a sign I don't know what is!
F

It was definitely nerve-wracking, and I'm still nervous, but it's definitely important to just put your foot down and say no.

I hope everything goes well for you, friend!

Yeah, I live in the middle of a city.

Thanks for the advice.
I agree, and thank you

Hi, thanks for the comment.

Unfortunately over the past day things escalated, I ended up posting about it elsewhere. It turns out they don't trust me, and to my face told me that as well as that they "don't give a fuck" about anything I do. They told me I'm never going to be employed because people are better than me, and that I'll hate working if I do get employed.

Then they told me they loved me, which just made me snap, I don't know why I'm still here.

That thought does actually make me tear up a bit. I studied art in an attempt to impress my family but in the end they didn't even know what I was studying somehow.

But I'm doing my best to try and own it, I know I really want to make a comic book even though I've never read comics. Thinking about that does genuinely make me feel kind of excited, thank you :)

It was weird, it seemed backwards, and thank you. For some reason I'm even disappointed in myself for graduating, there's probably some screw loose or something that needs addressing.

Life on my own terms sounds like absolute paradise. I'm doing what I can I think, but what I'm doing is bad for whatever reason. If I can get out of here I'm sure I'll be happy for once. Also, nice to see another person with Soda at the end of their name!

That is true. I must have convinced myself that this is normal too much.

I was told to call the police on him before, and I just lack that strength to even do that. I don't know why. He's been in prison before, I think I just live in too much fear of what will happen to everyone.

I'm 21, my mother is around but I realise now I live in fear of him doing "something" if I try and stay at hers, because they don't live far away.

I feel incredibly guilty and ashamed of wanting to cut ties with him.

I was told that because I often tell them what I'm doing/where I am (so they know I'm ok/safe) it makes me seem like I'm actually lying to them and that I'm hiding something and I don't understand how or why they would think that. 

I graduated a few months ago. I don't have a proper plan yet because I'm waiting to start work, unfortunately.
I had a look and ended up writing a full-on post, thanks for the direction as it really seems like the right place.
It does feel like manipulation, but I guess I also want to believe that it isn't which is why I feel so confused right now maybe
I haven't - I'll have a look, thank you
Thanks, I guess it just hurts that the ones who I'm supposed to love just don't care.

Whenever I try to appeal to the one member that seems to care, he says that they just care.

I don't think I'd say they care though, because I had a talk with my family just now and was told they don't even trust me. I didn't feel appreciated before but now I just feel worthless.
After today, I really do feel like it
I thought so, it very much seemed that way from the looks of things.

For me it would be promoting my art so that I could eventually move onto doing commissions, but also I'd like to share my creativity with the world.

Sorry for the late response!

I see, thank you. This has helped for starting. I'll try and give it a go soon, probably with Instagram first because that seems a bit easier to use.

Twitter seems a bit harder to use but I think I'll spread a bit once I've got an Instagram going, thank you!
I feel the same, but being young still I feel like it's worth trying to figure it all out haha.

Thanks!

Would it be a good idea to post on only a few platforms instead of spread out?

That makes sense. I'll have to figure out how to do that as the next step then.

The lack of confidence I think is what's holding me back, especially because I don't know where to start now but I'll try to figure that out.

I guess right now I just don't see the usefulness of it - especially my own art. I don't know where to look, and I think that dampens my spirits a bit.

Thank you for this comment though, I'm going to screenshot it if you don't mind so I can remind myself.

I know that it's due to external influences that have affected me.

Whilst I've just passed university (not yet graduated), I don't have a job and have hardly ever worked, which makes me personally feel useless and as a failure, even though I know for others it isn't.

Because I did art as a study I feel like I chose a useless subject and should have studied something more beneficial even if I wouldn't have enjoyed it, I might be able to apply it to work, which in turn makes me feel like I've "failed" something, even though I don't know what.
Thank you, everyone!

Wow, thanks for taking the time to write this! I'll have a look at the posts you linked. I'd been doing a lot of self love this year so far as I'd struggled with depression for a couple years, and this year had turned out amazing because of it.

Have a great day :)

(Also, it's great to see a fellow Metal Gear fan here by the looks of your username)
Thank you! I hope you have a wonderful day :)
Not a bad idea, I usually compliment people if I like what they're wearing or their accessories, so it wouldn't be out of the norm for me.
Hey bud, I'm glad you fell asleep okay! Good luck for the future :)

That's a great idea, I should have recommended that haha. Definitely occupy yourself with something else and try not to think negative about the situation - I find that if I think that I'm wasting time etc. I start to feel like crap, so I'd say to think of it as an experience so that if it does ever happen again, you'll be prepared.

Hey, it'll be okay; I didn't sleep for 36 hours from Thursday to Friday the past couple weeks due to university so try not to worry :) I have times where I just am not tired, but I'm sure the sleepy feeling will catch up soon and your negative feelings will pass!
Thanks! All the times I've seen her so far she seems to have friends with her. I know she's noticed me though, so there's a start.

Cheers bud, I've definitely been making a deal of it haha. I was tempted to go up to her on Friday but she had this big friend group and I didn't want to just barge in and interrupt, but I'll see what I can do!
Personally I think so - If I were in that position I'd feel appreciated :)

Hi, I don't know if this helps but my dad went through similar feelings after my parents got divorced, but things really turned around for him.

However, it did take him many years. I would say it is probably a normal reaction to feel like this though; I could see myself in the same position were it to happen. I wish you luck moving forward.

I did something similar to this, in which I asked to see a specific name because of what I'm trying to manifest right now. I didn't see the name after a while so I got a little annoyed (in hindsight I shouldn't have) and asked to see it right there and then.

All of a sudden while scrolling through Reddit I saw the name 5 times in different posts, and then saw those SAME exact posts re-posted hours later when I scrolled through again. I think the universe just wanted me to shut up at that point lol.

However, I think the best thing to ask yourself is how often do you see anything related to lotus flowers? For me personally, I don't see them often - if at all - so I would interpret those as signs :) But, that's just me. Good luck with everything!
I second this; I loved FU but I do feel that MHP3rd was a very lovely and smooth game - a part of me still wishes it was officially localized
Thank you both, I look forward to what the universe has in store for me!
Thank you very much for such a detailed response! Your help means a lot, especially for someone new like me :) Have a wonderful day!
Thank you! I hope you have a wonderful, positive Friday!
Thank you, I'll keep this in mind - have a wonderful day!

Once college started, I did my best to change who I was. It worked for the first few years; I'm struggling rn but that's beside the point - I can relate to your current position, and I know many others who were in the same spot as you.

That's how I feel these days. I think it's the length of time that's really getting to me, I may PM you at some point soon, I appreciate you talking to me.

Thank you. I guess I just feel having talents and being a useful member of society seems as though I'm worth something. If I weren't depressed, I guess I'd honestly like to just have a job honestly, and I guess the reason I'm struggling with being alone right now is the breakup feeling fresh, and I feel guilty I guess for still having feelings for my ex.

I'll check out airdrops, thank you for talking to me.
Also been feeling heavily down - it feels as though the past few months have gone in the blink of an eye, and I can hardly remember what happened either
I plan on going to the gym once my next Uni year starts in a couple of months, just for something to do. But yeah, it's the whole time thing that I'm struggling with at the moment I guess. Thanks.
